title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 001 ]

blocks.text: Boys and girls speak differently. Scientists say that their differences create problems when mothers talk to sons and fathers talk to daughters. For instance, a mother's good counsel may not work on her son, and a father's may not work on his daughter. That doesn't mean, though, that parents and their other-sex children are doomed to miscommunicate with each other. Their communication will be more successful if parents respect their other-sex child's different way of speaking.

readingSentences.english: Scientists say that their differences create problems when mothers talk to sons and fathers talk to daughters.
readingSentences.korean: 과학자들은 어머니가 아들에게, 아버지가 딸에게 말할 때 이 차이 때문에 문제가 생긴다고 말한다.

readingSentences.english: For instance, a mother's good counsel may not work on her son, and a father's may not work on his daughter.
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들어, 어머니의 좋은 조언이 아들에게는 통하지 않고, 아버지의 조언이 딸에게는 통하지 않을 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: That doesn't mean, though, that parents and their other-sex children are doomed to miscommunicate with each other.
readingSentences.korean: 하지만 그렇다고 해서 부모와 성별이 다른 자녀가 서로 의사소통에 실패할 운명이라는 뜻은 아니다.

readingSentences.english: Their communication will be more successful if parents respect their other-sex child's different way of speaking.
readingSentences.korean: 부모가 성별이 다른 자녀의 다른 말하기 방식을 존중한다면 그들의 대화는 더 성공적일 것이다.
